thread:
jon: Quick design sync — iterating on the Invoke Inspector for the playground. Main questions: where to show the function signature preview, and how dense the run timeline should be. quick eyeballs? (I'll paste mocks below)

maria: Love the direction. My instinct: signature preview should be visible inline above the tool output, not collapsed. People glance for param types. Inline but collapsible.

shaun: Agree. Also prefer a compact 'chip' style for params when there are >3. Example: `user_id: string · limit?: number` (chip) — clicking expands detailed description.

emma: Accessibility nit: if you make the chips interactive, ensure they're keyboard focusable and have aria-expanded. Also add `aria-label="Expand parameter details"` on the chevron.

jon: good call. For copy UX: should copy JSON schema or human-readable call? Thinking there's two buttons: 'Copy schema' and 'Copy example'.

maria: Two buttons is fine, but group them under one overflow menu on mobile. Also add a single-line micro-copy under the signature: 'Click to copy schema' so it's discoverable.

shaun: Run timeline: want to show small inline events: call start, tool invocation, model tokens, fallback. But hide kv cache events by default. Maybe a density toggle 'Compact | Verbose'.

run-bot: runbot: invocation 1954321000.001 - model: redwood-7b - duration 320ms - tokens: 124 - fallback: none

jon: Example of compact signature mock: ```json
{"name":"get_user","params":[{"name":"user_id","type":"string"},{"name":"include_metadata","type":"bool","optional":true}]}
``` Would we show the whole JSON inline? feels noisy.

emma: If you show JSON, use a collapsed code block with 'Show more' to avoid noise. Make sure the copy button targets the exact block (aria-controls + aria-describedby).

maria: Also UX: when you hover a param in signature show a tooltip with an example value and a short usage note, not the entire description. Keeps timeline compact.

shaun: Roll history interaction: when you click a timeline row, open a side-by-side diff between previous and current function outputs. Diff should highlight structural changes in schema keys.

jon: noted. One more: breadcrumbs for model/route at top of inspector (like `Playground > Route: /chat > Model: redwood-7b`). helps debugging during A/B rollouts.

emma: :thumbsup: Accessibility checklist happy path: keyboard nav, focus order, visible focus rings, readable contrast for chips, screen reader labels for timeline events.

jon: ok i'll produce a second pass with updated mocks: move signature inline collapsible, chips for params, compact/verbose toggle for timeline, two-copy options, aria labels. tagging @maria @shaun @emma for final thumbs.

maria: :thumbsup: looks good. minor copy tweak: change "Copy example" -> "Copy example payload" to be explicit.

shaun: I'll prototype the chips + tooltip microcopy today and drop a GIF in this thread.
